say:2:1810532101:1.text: You brainless living brat... <shk>I told you to stop! Are you deaf?!</shk>
say:2:1810532101:1.source_cn: 混账的生者小子……<shk>老身喊你住手，你耳朵聋了吗...

say:3:1810532102:1.text: It was trying to kill us!

say:4:1810532103:1.text: That's not Hilda's fault! You only have yourselves to blame!
say:4:1810532103:1.source_cn: 那也不是希尔达的错，只能怪你们自己！

say:5:1810532104:1.text: I warned you a thousand times, you living sack of meat. Return to the Bone Hut before the full moon! But no, you ignored me completely!
say:5:1810532104:1.source_cn: 老身千叮万嘱，务必要在满月之前返回骨屋，你们就只当作耳旁风！

say:6:1810532105:1.text: If you'd listened, Hilda never would have attacked you! <style="highlight">She was once a resident of this village</style>. She's meant to protect me and you from all those Bantus lapdogs!
say:6:1810532105:1.source_cn: 若是你们听进去了老身说的话，希尔达断不可能袭击你们！<...

choice_prompt:7:1810532105.text: If you'd listened, Hilda never would have attacked you! <style="highlight">She was once a resident of this village</style>. She's meant to protect me and you from all those Bantus lapdogs!
choice_prompt:7:1810532105.source_cn: 若是你们听进去了老身说的话，希尔达断不可能袭击你们！<style=highlight>她原本就是这夕染村的一员</style>，只会庇护老身与你们，抵抗班题斯的那群狗腿子！

say:8:1810532106:0.text: No. <style="highlight">Hilda used to be a normal Graveborn like the rest of us</style>. As for how she ended up like this... *Sigh*

say:11:1810532107:0.text: I'm sorry, Baba. This is my fault, I got carried away. Please don't blame them.
say:11:1810532107:0.source_cn: 抱歉，婆婆，都怪我一时玩得太高兴了……你不要责怪他们。

say:12:1810532108:1.text: Don't apologize to me, child. Right now, <style="highlight">helping Hilda patch her limbs back together</style> is all that matters! If those Bantus dogs sniff out that she's wounded, they'll storm Twilight Village at any moment.
say:12:1810532108:1.source_cn: 和老身解释也没用，此刻最重要的是<style=high...

say:13:1810532109:1.text: Leave through the north side of the village and cross the forest. On the highest ground, you'll find a massive <style="highlight">golden maple tree</style>. Inside that tree, there's a <style="highlight">hollow</style> large enough to enter.
say:13:1810532109:1.source_cn: 从村子北侧出去，跨过低谷树林，地势最高的一处有<sty...

say:14:1810532110:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You and Rain go and retrieve <style="highlight">Hilda's keepsake</style>.
say:14:1810532110:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You and Rain go and retrieve <style="highlight">Hilda's keepsake</style>.
say:14:1810532110:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You and Rain go and retrieve <style="highlight">Hilda's keepsake</style>.

choice_prompt:15:1810532113.text: No problem. Leave it to us!

say:16:1810532111:0.text: You and Rain are the only ones I trust!
say:16:1810532111:0.source_cn: 老身只信得过你和里纳！
say:16:1810532111:0.male: You and Rain are the only ones I trust!
say:16:1810532111:0.female: You and Rain are the only ones I trust!

say:17:1810532113:0.text: No problem. Leave it to us!

say:21:1810532114:0.text: Thane and I should come too. The more people we have, the safer it'll be.
say:21:1810532114:0.source_cn: 我和瑟恩一起去，多一个人就多一份保障。

say:22:1810532115:0.text: Stop right there! What are two living folk going to do? Make more trouble? Stay put right here!
say:22:1810532115:0.source_cn: 站住！两个生者去干嘛？添乱吗？给老身在这里老实待着！

say:23:1810532116:0.text: Especially you, wretched boy! I know you hate the Graveborn. Don't think I'll let you take another opportunity to hurt Hilda.
say:23:1810532116:0.source_cn: 尤其是你——混小子！老身知道你看亡灵不顺眼，你别想再趁...

say:24:1810532117:1.text: If she's truly an enemy of Bantus, I won't harm her. Even if she is a Graveborn.
say:24:1810532117:1.source_cn: 她既与班题斯为敌，我就不会伤害她——哪怕她是亡灵。

say:25:1810532118:1.text: But if she threatens Estrilda or Baden again, I won't hold back.
say:25:1810532118:1.source_cn: 但如果她再敢碰爱丝和巴登，我不会手软。

say:26:1810532119:0.text: You...! Even if it costs me my life, I won't let you go!
say:26:1810532119:0.source_cn: 你……！就算今天要拼了这条老命，老身也绝不让你去！

say:28:1810532121:1.text: You know what they're capable of. Especially Baden. Don't you trust him?
say:28:1810532121:1.source_cn: 你最清楚他们两人的实力，不是吗？尤其是巴登的！你难道不...

say:31:1810532122:1.text: Uh... I'm still not entirely convinced I'm actually Baden.
say:31:1810532122:1.source_cn: 呃，我还不确定自己是不是巴登呢。

say:34:1810532124:0.text: ... Very well. I'll stay here for now. Protect yourself and Baden, and stop him from doing anything stupid if you have to.
say:34:1810532124:0.source_cn: ……好，我暂时留在这里待命。保护好你自己和巴登——必要...
say:34:1810532124:0.male: ... Very well. I'll stay here for now. Protect yourself and Baden, and stop him from doing anything stupid if you have to.
say:34:1810532124:0.female: ... Very well. I'll stay here for now. Protect yourself and Baden, and stop him from doing anything stupid if you have to.

say:35:1810532125:0.text: You're a strange man. What stupid thing could I possibly do?
say:35:1810532125:0.source_cn: 你这人真奇怪，我能做什么傻事，放心吧。

choice:33:0:1.text: Leave it to me. You taught me swordsmanship, yeah?
choice:33:0:1.source_cn: 交给我吧，我的剑术可是你教的
choice:33:0:1.male: Leave it to me. You taught me swordsmanship, yeah?
choice:33:0:1.female: Leave it to me. You taught me swordsmanship, yeah?

choice:33:1:2.text: It's a simple errand. We'll be back before you know it.
choice:33:1:2.source_cn: 这么简单的事，我去去就来
choice:33:1:2.male: It's a simple errand. We'll be back before you know it.
choice:33:1:2.female: It's a simple errand. We'll be back before you know it.

say:38:1810532112:0.text: Did I stutter?! No one else can be trusted!
say:38:1810532112:0.source_cn: 不行！除了你和里纳，其他人都不可信！
say:38:1810532112:0.male: Did I stutter?! No one else can be trusted!
say:38:1810532112:0.female: Did I stutter?! No one else can be trusted!

choice:7:0:1.female: The villagers of Twilight Village were treants?
